rubric.0: Broken: cuts mid-word or merges broken fragments so meaning/readability is disrupted.

rubric.2: Sufficient: top-3 chunks contain all required exact numbers/facts/conditions needed to answer faithfully.

rubric.0: Off-target: top-3 misses the required evidence section/condition.
